title: Warehouse Shift Supervisor (m/f/d)
description:
Supervise a shift of 25 parcel handlers at our regional hub.

What you'll do
- Lead the shift and allocate tasks across inbound and outbound
- Monitor throughput and safety
- Report daily performance to our UK operations team

What you bring
- 3+ years in warehouse or parcel operations, ideally as a shift lead
- English at C1 level (spoken and written) is required, as daily reporting is in English
- Forklift licence
